results.title: Cgs International Sekuritas Indonesia sells shares of PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk
results.body: Cgs International Sekuritas Indonesia's disposal of BRMS shares is part of a larger exposure reduction that sees Cgs International Sekuritas Indonesia trimming position across 2 companies in the last 6 months. Alongside BRMS, Cgs International Sekuritas Indonesia has also disposed shares of HILL, totaling IDR 355,067,083,530 across all disposals in this period.
